name: Mobile profile and bottom navigation
description: Check the profile and all mobile navigation destinations.
steps: Use bottom navigation to open Avatar, Catalog, Inventory and Friends
Switch through About, Creations, Favorites, Inventory and Badges
expected: Every destination renders and the bottom navigation stays above the iPhone safe area.

name: Backstage long-press and autosave
description: Verify the one-second hidden settings gesture.
steps: Hold the very top edge for one second
Change the display name and close Backstage
expected: Backstage opens from the charging strip, changes persist and there is no visible editor shortcut.

name: Public Roblox profile import without credentials
description: Import available public Roblox profile fields using only a username.
expected: Available public data imports without requesting a password, cookie, token or login.

name: Avatar, inventory and catalog
description: Verify local avatar and inventory workflows and public read-only lookups.
steps: Open Inventory and search for an item
Open Catalog and search a numeric asset ID
expected: Inventory search remains focused, wear state updates, and catalog thumbnails can be added locally.

name: Friends, creations, badges and profile backup
description: Verify editable profile sections and local backup.
steps: Add a friend, creation and badge
Open Settings and reset with confirmation
expected: Profile sections update, JSON backup restores data, and reset requires confirmation.
